title: Over 60 farmers trained on ginger, turmeric cultivation

ai.summary: Nagaland University's AICRP on Spices conducted training for over 60 farmers on pest and disease management in ginger and turmeric cultivation, with practical demonstrations and distribution of tools.

facts.claim: More than 60 progressive spice farmers participated in the outreach programme
facts.quote: More than 60 progressive spice farmers participated in the outreach programme, which was held at Chümoukedima village, Kuxho village and Luzheto village in Niuland district.

facts.claim: The programmes were inaugurated by assistant professor, Dr. Graceli Yepthomi
facts.quote: The programmes were inaugurated by assistant professor, Dr. Graceli Yepthomi, who highlighted the importance of healthy planting materials and scientific crop management practices for successful ginger and turmeric cultivation.

facts.claim: Farmers were trained to identify major insect pests and diseases affecting ginger and turmeric
facts.quote: Farmers were trained to identify major insect pests and diseases affecting ginger and turmeric and were introduced to integrated pest and disease management strategies.

facts.claim: The sessions covered rhizome treatment using Trichoderma, hot water treatment and recommended fungicide applications
facts.quote: The sessions covered rhizome treatment using Trichoderma, hot water treatment and recommended fungicide applications.

facts.claim: Farmers were also trained in cultural practices such as field sanitation, proper drainage, safe disposal of infected plant materials, intercropping, crop rotation and timely harvesting
facts.quote: Farmers were also trained in cultural practices such as field sanitation, proper drainage, safe disposal of infected plant materials, intercropping, crop rotation and timely harvesting.

facts.claim: Practical demonstrations on the use of eco-friendly agricultural inputs were conducted
facts.quote: In addition, practical demonstrations on the use of eco-friendly agricultural inputs were conducted to promote sustainable farming practices.

facts.claim: Minor farm tools and plant protection inputs were distributed to all participants
facts.quote: To encourage the adoption of improved cultivation practices, minor farm tools and plant protection inputs were distributed to all participants.
